name: bukusupe
description: Chrome のブックマークを意味で並べた宇宙地図として見る拡張機能

scripts.check:ext: npm run build:debug >/dev/null && npm run build:web:debug >/dev/null || exit 1; node scripts/check-dist.mjs; d=$?; node scripts/check-release.mjs; r=$?; node scripts/check-store.mjs; o=$?; node scripts/check-fresh.mjs; c=$?; node scripts/check-extension.mjs; e=$?; node scripts/check-flight.mjs; f=$?; node scripts/check-flight-controls.mjs; g=$?; node scripts/check-idle.mjs; i=$?; node scripts/check-today.mjs; t=$?; node scripts/check-safety.mjs; s=$?; node scripts/check-web.mjs; w=$?; node scripts/check-cache.mjs; k=$?; node scripts/check-constellation.mjs; n=$?; node scripts/check-selection.mjs; l=$?; node scripts/check-model-consent.mjs; m=$?; node scripts/check-label-open.mjs; p=$?; node scripts/check-i18n.mjs; x=$?; node scripts/check-language.mjs; y=$?; exit $((d | r | o | c | e | f | g | i | t | s | w | k | n | l | m | p | x | y))
scripts.check:flight: npm run build:debug >/dev/null && node scripts/check-flight.mjs && node scripts/check-flight-controls.mjs
